title: Kitchens (Molteni / EDM)
activity: Kitchen units, stone worktops, appliances – first fix, second fix and handover
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Room ready – walls boarded and finished, services in the right positions for the kitchen layout?

questions.q: Base and wall units level, plumb and fixed solid, aligned with each other?
questions.source: Molteni kitchen ITP ESC-00014 – 1st fix: base/wall units

questions.q: Door and drawer gaps equal and as the approved kitchen drawing, fronts flush with each other and the island; drawers close fully without bouncing back; soft-close working?

questions.q: Scribes, surround, bookcase and finger rail tight and neat?

questions.q: Socket and grid switch cut-outs square, neat and matching the kitchen elevation?

questions.q: Waste and service holes fire stopped and photographed before the back panels go on?

questions.q: Worktop and island level and supported; gap to flanking joinery about 4 mm (7–8 mm rejected); joints tight and flush?

guide.title: Kitchen stone – SJWS benchmark limits
rows: about 4 mm each end (7–8 mm rejected – BM-51)
corners rounded, square to the plate
on site – never cut from the model (BM-48)
guide.src: Block 5 benchmarks BM-48, BM-51; Field issues

questions.q: Sink sealed, overflow connected, tap hole and air switch where the elevation shows?

Metal bars and trims fixed straight, level and secure, ends undamaged?
All appliances fitted and level, integrated doors flush with the furniture; stacked ovens line up with no step?

questions.q: Each appliance switched on and working (functionality test)?
questions.source: Molteni kitchen ITP ESC-00014 – appliance functionality check

questions.q: Tap working, no leaks under the sink, bin and cutlery tray fitted?

questions.q: Kitchen LED lighting working and aligned?
questions.source: Molteni kitchen ITP ESC-00014 – 2nd fix: LED light

questions.q: Units cleaned out underneath and photographed before plinths go on; plinths level, flush, mastic neat?
questions.source: Molteni kitchen ITP ESC-00014 – 2nd fix: plinth, mastic
Molteni kitchen ITP ESC-00014 – clean down and protection

questions.q: Free from scratches, chips and damage?

notOk.t: Worktop / splashback gap to flanking joinery over ~4 mm (7–8 mm rejected at benchmark)
Doors or appliances not aligned / not flush
Drawers bounce back or doors don't soft-close
Hinge caps missing, wrong colour screws or beading
Marks, chips or scratches on doors and worktops
Stacked ovens not lining up – step between top and bottom
Drawers bouncing back out or not closing fully
Plinths fitted before units cleaned out underneath
Back panel fitted before the waste hole was fire stopped
Metal bar loose, uneven or missing

ask.q: What gap between worktop/splashback and the joinery?
ask.a: About 4 mm – 7–8 mm is rejected (Block 5 benchmark BM-51). Templated on site.

ask.q: When do the plinths go on?
ask.a: Only after units are cleaned out underneath, with photos.

ask.q: Is the waste hole fire stopped before the back panel?
ask.a: Yes – fire stopped and photographed first.

ask.q: How do you check the appliances line up?
ask.a: Ovens stacked level with no step; integrated doors flush with the furniture.
